source_metadata.scenario: Reduce the coal plants usage by 25 percent in delhi by 2028
source_metadata.llm_rationale: The reduction of coal plant usage by 25% in Delhi by 2028 is expected to lower PM2.5 levels, which will decrease the health burden associated with respiratory issues, thereby justifying a moderate increase in beta_base and beta_sensitivity due to existing fossil fuel reliance. The health impacts observed necessitate a higher lambda_rate, while the implementation of clean energy policies supports a slight increase in kappa.
